title: The ultimate tree house onto a mountain
content: Ok, last night I had the coolest NEW dream that I wish I never woke up from. If heaven exists that would be my closest 2nd. In the dream I lived in a giant living Redwood tree. It was about halfway from the bottom to the top and 3 stories high and oval shaped. An elevator was built inside the treethat took us up and down to the underground storage/ treasury. My brother live on the First floor of the tree house I lived on the second floor and the 3rd floor was a grand bath bonsai garden. The floor was concrete and stone and the inner walls were a mix of wood and stone with outerwalls being glass. The ceiling on the bathouse was also glass giving an amazing view of the stars. It was soo soo incredible no houses in sight of this mega tree house. Just chilleb.
